menu.title: The noon shade keeper
menu.whole_scene: At the edge of a sun-struck civic reading court, a canopy keeper eases a handwheel and interlinked louver panels rotate overhead; the first clean band of shade reaches the waiting readers. Human concentration and collective relief carry the photograph.

menu.title: The first crossing
menu.whole_scene: A bridge steward lowers a narrow pedestrian drawbridge toward the opposite stone landing. A measured queue waits behind the steward as the exposed winding train and suspended counterweight give the public crossing a visible cause. Anticipation lies in the final remaining gap.

menu.title: The city takes a breath
menu.whole_scene: A municipal bell keeper releases a small lever in a Renaissance civic loggia while a visible wheel-and-cam train brings a bronze striker toward the town bell. The square below pauses for the daily opening signal. The instant before sound creates the tension.

menu.title: Opening the seed hall
menu.whole_scene: A seed-hall registrar turns a crank beside a glass-and-stone municipal conservatory. A linked roof iris opens into morning light above exchange tables while the registrar watches the first illuminated seedlings. The shared institution is activated by a small human effort.
